name: Alchemy Laboratory
what: Use: Places an Alchemy Laboratory usable for recipes that require it, and provides all of the benefits of a Mana Well. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over a Mana Well to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Flask of Natural Accuracy
what: Use: Increases your Stamina by 30. While in Mount Hyjal, Hyjal Summit, and the Barrow Deeps, you also gain 2% Hit Chance. Lasts for 2 hrs. You can only have the effect of one flask at a time. This effect persists through death. (3 Sec Cooldown)

name: Flask of Natural Aggression
what: Use: Increases your Stamina by 30. While in Mount Hyjal, Hyjal Summit, and the Barrow Deeps, you also gain 2% Critical Strike Chance. Lasts for 2 hrs. You can only have the effect of one flask at a time. This effect persists through death. (3 Sec Cooldown)

name: Flask of Natural Precision
what: Use: Increases your Stamina by 30. While in Mount Hyjal, Hyjal Summit, and the Barrow Deeps, you also gain 2% reduced chance to be dodged or parried. Lasts for 2 hrs. You can only have the effect of one flask at a time. This effect persists through death. (3 Sec Cooldown)

name: Flask of Natural Swiftness
what: Use: Increases your Stamina by 30. While in Mount Hyjal, Hyjal Summit, and the Barrow Deeps, you also gain 2% Haste. Lasts for 2 hrs. You can only have the effect of one flask at a time. This effect persists through death. (3 Sec Cooldown)

name: Arcanite Blacksmith Hammer
what: Chance on hit: Stun the target for 1 sec.

name: Master Forge
what: Use: Places a Master Forge usable for recipes that require it, and provides all of the benefits of a Sharpening Wheel. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over a Sharpening Wheel to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Iron Oven
what: Use: Places an Iron Oven required for the most advanced cooking recipes. Requires a Cooking Fire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Arcane Forge
what: Use: Places an Arcane Forge usable for recipes that require it, and provides all the benefits of an Enchanted Lute. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over an Enchanted Lute to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Dormant Heart of the Mountain
what: Equip: Your casts of Greater Heal, Healing Touch, Healing Wave, or Holy Light in combat grant up to 40 increased healing and up to 13 increased damage for 15 sec.

name: Frozen Heart of the Mountain
what: Use: Increases Frost and Shadow spell damage done by up to 29 for 15 sec. This effect is doubled in Snowy areas. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Idol of Swiftness
what: Equip: Reduces the cooldown of your Swiftmend spell by 3 sec.

name: Idol of the Ursine Twins
what: Equip: Your Lacerate hits have a 10% chance to reset the cooldown on Primal Bite.

name: Molten Heart of the Mountain
what: Use: Increases Attack Power by 55 for 15 sec. This effect is doubled in Volcanic areas. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Anarchist's Workbench
what: Use: Places an Anarchist's Workbench usable for recipes that require it. Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Dimensional Transporter - Mt. Hyjal
what: Use: Rips the dimensional walls asunder and transports you to Kaylaena's Workshop on Mount Hyjal. Technical problems have a high chance to occur with this mad combination of goblin and gnomish engineering. (4 Hr Cooldown)

name: EZ-Thro Thorium Grenade
what: Use: Inflicts 300 to 500 Fire damage and stuns targets for 3 sec in a 3 yd radius. Any damage will break the effect. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: Gnomish Poultryizer
what: Use: Turns the target into a chicken for 15 sec. Well, that is assuming the transmogrification polarity has not been reversed... (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Loot-A-Rang
what: Use: Retrieves the loot from a nearby corpse. (3 Sec Cooldown)

name: SAF-T Clever Dynamite
what: Use: Inflicts 340 to 460 Fire damage in a 5 yd radius. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: Satchel of Dark Iron Bombs
what: Equip: Thrown attacks explode on impact, causing 4 to 37 Fire damage to nearby enemies.

name: Stealthman 52
what: Use: Cloaks the user in a stealth field for up to 1 min. Cannot be used in combat. The field lasts for up to 6 sec after moving. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Ultralight Goblin Glider
what: Use: Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Ultrasafe Rechargeable Battery
what: Use: Restores 3 charges to a SAF-T or EZ-Thro brand device in your possession that does not involve explosions. It would be completely Unsafe with explosives. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: Plague Doctor's Laboratory
what: Use: Places a Plague Doctor's Laboratory that contains healing potions and poultices, and provides all of the benefits of a First Aid Kit. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over a First Aid Kit to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Sewing Machine
what: Use: Places a Sewing Machine usable for recipes that require it, and provides all of the benefits of a Camp Tent. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over a Camp Tent to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Loom
what: Use: Places a Loom usable for recipes that require it, and provides all the benefits of a Faction Banner. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over a Faction Banner to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hr Cooldown)
